# Panduan Deployment ke Shared Hosting PHP (cPanel / DirectAdmin / VPS)

Panduan langkah demi langkah untuk memasang **Support Septian** pada URL produksi:
`https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support`

---

## Prasyarat Hosting
- **PHP 8.1 / 8.2 / 8.3**
- **MySQL 8.0+** atau **MariaDB 10.4+**
- Ekstensi PHP aktif: `pdo_mysql`, `openssl`, `mbstring`, `json`, `dom`, `fileinfo`, `curl`
- *(Opsional jika memakai mode Google App Password untuk membaca Inbox)*: aktifkan ekstensi `imap` di menu **Select PHP Version** pada cPanel.
- SSL/HTTPS aktif untuk `https://septianfr.web.id` (wajib untuk Google OAuth 2.0).

---

## Langkah 1 — Siapkan Folder `vendor/` (Google API PHP Client & PHPMailer)

Jika hosting **mendukung SSH / Terminal**:
```bash
cd ~/public_html/mail/support
composer require google/apiclient:^2.18 phpmailer/phpmailer:^6.9
```
Atau jalankan di komputer lokal Anda pada folder `support-septian/`:
```bash
composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
```
Folder `mail/support/vendor/` akan terbentuk berisi `google/apiclient` dan `phpmailer/phpmailer` (ukuran ringan karena `composer.json` sudah mengaktifkan `Google\Task\Composer::cleanup` khusus `Gmail` & `Oauth2`). Kompres `vendor/` menjadi ZIP dan ekstrak di `public_html/mail/support/vendor/`.

---

## Langkah 2 — Buat Database MySQL di cPanel

1. Buka **MySQL® Databases** di cPanel.
2. Buat database baru (misalnya `septianf_support`).
3. Buat user database baru dengan kata sandi kuat.
4. Tambahkan user tersebut ke database dengan hak akses **ALL PRIVILEGES**.
5. *(Opsional jika tidak memakai auto-import di `install.php`)*: Impor file `database.sql` melalui **phpMyAdmin**.

---

## Langkah 3 — Unggah File ke `public_html/mail/support/`

Struktur akhir di server hosting:
```
/home/username/
├── support-septian-private/        <-- (Disarankan) Pindahkan config.php ke sini setelah instalasi
│   └── config.php                  (chmod 0600)
└── public_html/
    ├── logo.png                    (https://septianfr.web.id/logo.png)
    └── mail/
        └── support/
            ├── .htaccess
            ├── index.php
            ├── login.php
            ├── logout.php
            ├── dashboard.php
            ├── inbox.php
            ├── sent.php
            ├── drafts.php
            ├── starred.php
            ├── spam.php
            ├── trash.php
            ├── compose.php
            ├── view-email.php
            ├── templates.php
            ├── template-preview.php
            ├── gmail-connection.php
            ├── settings.php
            ├── profile.php
            ├── security.php
            ├── install.php
            ├── oauth/
            │   ├── connect.php
            │   ├── callback.php    <-- URL: https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/oauth/callback.php
            │   └── disconnect.php
            ├── api/
            ├── assets/
            ├── includes/
            ├── storage/            (chmod 0750)
            │   ├── tokens/         (chmod 0750)
            │   └── logs/           (chmod 0750)
            ├── templates/
            └── vendor/             (hasil Composer)
```

Pastikan `database.sql` berada di `public_html/mail/support/database.sql` saat menjalankan `install.php`.

---

## Langkah 4 — Jalankan Instalasi Web

1. Kunjungi `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/install.php`.
2. Pastikan seluruh item pada bagian **Pemeriksaan Lingkungan Server PHP** berstatus **Siap**.
3. Isi detail database MySQL, akun admin pertama, identitas Support Septian F. R., dan kredensial OAuth / App Password.
4. Klik **Selesaikan Instalasi Support Septian**.

---

## Langkah 5 — Hardening Keamanan Pasca-Instalasi (Wajib)

1. **Pindahkan File Konfigurasi ke Luar `public_html`** (jika hosting mengizinkan akses direktori home):
   - Buat folder `/home/username/support-septian-private/` (`chmod 0700`).
   - Pindahkan `public_html/mail/support/storage/app-config.php` menjadi `/home/username/support-septian-private/config.php` (`chmod 0600`).
   - `includes/config.php` otomatis mendeteksi lokasi tersebut terlebih dahulu.
2. **Hapus File Instalasi**:
   - Hapus `public_html/mail/support/install.php` dan `public_html/mail/support/database.sql` setelah instalasi sukses.
3. **Verifikasi Proteksi `.htaccess`**:
   - Buka `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/includes/config.php` → harus mengembalikan **403 Forbidden**.
   - Buka `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/storage/tokens/` → harus mengembalikan **403 Forbidden**.
4. **Hubungkan Gmail & Verifikasi DKIM**:
   - Login ke `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/login.php`.
   - Buka menu **Koneksi Gmail**, hubungkan akun `support.septianfr@gmail.com` via OAuth 2.0 atau masukkan Google App Password 16 digit (PHPMailer `smtp.gmail.com:465` SSL, `SMTPAuth=true`).
   - Klik **Jalankan Diagnostik SMTP**, lalu kirim **1 Email Tes** ke alamat Gmail lain milik admin dan pastikan di Gmail penerima menu **Show Original** menunjukkan **`DKIM: PASS`**.

# Support Septian — Aplikasi Manajemen Email Customer Support (PHP 8.1+ & MySQL PDO)

Aplikasi web manajemen email resmi untuk **Support Septian F. R.** yang terhubung langsung ke akun Gmail **`support.septianfr@gmail.com`**, dibangun murni menggunakan **HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript Vanilla, PHP 8.1+, dan MySQL PDO** tanpa React, TypeScript, Node.js, maupun proses kompilasi frontend.

---

## Identitas Resmi Aplikasi

| Komponen | Nilai |
| --- | --- |
| **Nama Aplikasi** | Support Septian |
| **Identitas Resmi** | Support Septian F. R. |
| **Email Gmail Resmi** | `support.septianfr@gmail.com` |
| **Website** | `https://septianfr.web.id` |
| **URL Aplikasi** | `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support` |
| **OAuth Callback URI** | `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/oauth/callback.php` |
| **Logo Resmi** | `https://septianfr.web.id/logo.png` |
| **Alamat Lengkap** | H4GM+4XX, Jl. PUK Muntur, Ranjeng, Kec. Losarang, Kabupaten Indramayu, Jawa Barat 45253 |

---

## Fitur Utama

1. **Integrasi Gmail Sungguhan (Dual Mode)**:
   - **Google Gmail API (OAuth 2.0 Web Application)** menggunakan `google/apiclient`, dengan verifikasi `state` anti-CSRF, auto-refresh token, deteksi token dicabut, serta validasi ketat bahwa akun yang terhubung wajib `support.septianfr@gmail.com`.
   - **Google App Password (PHPMailer SMTP SSL:465 + IMAP)** menggunakan `phpmailer/phpmailer` ke `smtp.gmail.com:465` (`ENCRYPTION_SMTPS`, `SMTPAuth = true`) dengan identitas `Support Septian F. R. <support.septianfr@gmail.com>` sehingga penandatanganan DKIM dikelola resmi oleh server Google (`DKIM=PASS`), lengkap dengan **Panel Diagnostik SMTP** & tombol **Kirim 1 Email Tes**.
2. **Fitur Email Lengkap**:
   - Kotak Masuk (Inbox), Terkirim (Sent), Draft, Berbintang (Starred), Spam, Sampah (Trash).
   - Membaca thread percakapan lengkap dengan sanitasi HTML anti-XSS.
   - Balas Pesan (Reply), Balas Semua (Reply All), Kirim Baru (Compose), Teruskan (Forward), Simpan Draft.
   - Aksi massal & tunggal: Tandai Sudah/Belum Dibaca, Bintang, Arsip, Spam, Sampah, Hapus Permanen.
   - Pencarian email lintas folder, pagination Gmail, serta unggah & unduh lampiran tervalidasi.
3. **Sistem Template Email Profesional (Gaya Google)**:
   - 8+ template siap pakai (Balasan Standar, Konfirmasi Penerimaan Pesan, Informasi Sedang Diproses, Permintaan Informasi Tambahan, Penyelesaian Masalah, Ucapan Terima Kasih, Balasan Umum, Pesan Baru, dan Draft).
   - HTML inline CSS lebar 600px, background putih, logo & footer identitas resmi Support Septian F. R., responsif di Android, iPhone, dan Desktop.
   - Variabel dinamis: `{nama_penerima}`, `{email_penerima}`, `{subjek}`, `{tanggal}`, `{nama_pengirim}`, `{isi_pesan}`, `{nama_perusahaan}`, `{website}`, `{email_support}`.
4. **Keamanan Standar Produksi**:
   - `password_hash()` & `password_verify()`, session cookie aman (`HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Secure`), CSRF token pada seluruh form & API, PDO prepared statements (`ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false`), rate limiting login, enkripsi AES-256-GCM untuk Client Secret, OAuth Token, & App Password, `.htaccess` pemblokir direktori sensitif, serta modal konfirmasi wajib sebelum mengirim email.

---

## Instalasi Cepat

### 1. Instalasi Library Google API PHP Client & PHPMailer (Composer)
Jalankan perintah berikut di folder root paket `support-septian/`:

```bash
composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
```

Perintah tersebut otomatis memasang `google/apiclient` dan `phpmailer/phpmailer` ke dalam `mail/support/vendor/` serta membersihkan service Google selain `Gmail` & `Oauth2` agar ukuran folder `vendor/` tetap ringan saat diunggah ke shared hosting.

### 2. Unggah ke Hosting PHP
Unggah isi folder `mail/support/` ke direktori:
```
public_html/mail/support/
```
*(Sertakan folder `mail/support/vendor/` hasil Composer serta salin `database.sql` ke `public_html/mail/support/database.sql` selama instalasi, lalu hapus file `database.sql` & `install.php` setelah selesai).*

### 3. Jalankan Web Installer
Buka browser dan akses:
```
https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/install.php
```
Isi:
1. Koneksi MySQL (host, nama database, username, password).
2. Akun administrator pertama.
3. Identitas resmi Support Septian F. R.
4. Kredensial Google OAuth 2.0 (Client ID & Secret) dan/atau Google App Password 16 digit.

### 4. Konfigurasi Google Cloud Console (Untuk OAuth 2.0)
1. Buka [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/) → buat/pilih proyek.
2. Aktifkan **Gmail API**.
3. Konfigurasikan **OAuth Consent Screen** (External/Internal), tambahkan scopes:
   - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly`
   - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send`
   - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify`
   Tambahkan `support.septianfr@gmail.com` pada **Test Users** bila aplikasi masih dalam status Testing.
4. Buat **OAuth Client ID** dengan tipe **Web Application**:
   - **Authorized JavaScript origins**: `https://septianfr.web.id`
   - **Authorized redirect URIs**: `https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/oauth/callback.php`
5. Masukkan Client ID dan Client Secret pada halaman **Koneksi Gmail**, lalu klik **Hubungkan Gmail**.

### 5. Alternatif: Konfigurasi Google App Password (PHPMailer SMTP SSL:465)
1. Buka akun Google `support.septianfr@gmail.com` → **Security** → aktifkan **2-Step Verification**.
2. Buka menu **App Passwords**, buat sandi aplikasi bernama `Support Septian`.
3. Masuk ke halaman **Koneksi Gmail** di aplikasi Support Septian, masukkan 16 karakter App Password tersebut, klik **Jalankan Diagnostik SMTP & IMAP**, lalu simpan & aktifkan.
4. Gunakan panel **Tes Pengiriman Email (1 Email Percobaan)** untuk mengirim 1 email tes ke Gmail admin lain, lalu periksa **Show Original (Tampilkan Asli)** di Gmail penerima untuk memastikan `Authentication-Results` menampilkan `DKIM=PASS`.

Lihat `DEPLOYMENT.md` untuk panduan lengkap deployment pada cPanel / Shared Hosting PHP.

# ============================================================================
# SUPPORT SEPTIAN — Apache .htaccess Security & Routing
# Path: /mail/support/.htaccess
# ============================================================================

Options -Indexes -MultiViews
ServerSignature Off

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /mail/support/

    # Paksa HTTPS di produksi (nonaktifkan hanya saat testing lokal)
    RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
    RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^localhost [NC]
    RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^127\.0\.0\.1 [NC]
    RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

    # Blokir akses langsung ke folder internal sensitif
    RewriteRule ^includes/ - [F,L]
    RewriteRule ^storage/ - [F,L]
    RewriteRule ^vendor/ - [F,L]
    RewriteRule ^templates/ - [F,L]

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — API: Message Actions (Read, Unread, Star, Archive, Spam, Trash, Delete)
 * POST /mail/support/api/actions.php
 * Body JSON: { "action": "mark_read|mark_unread|star|unstar|archive|trash|untrash|spam|not_spam|delete", "ids": ["..."] }
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/gmail-service.php';

require_admin(true);

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Metode tidak diizinkan.'], 405);
}

$data = !empty($_POST) ? $_POST : read_json_input();
require_csrf(true);

$action = trim((string) ($data['action'] ?? ''));
$ids    = $data['ids'] ?? [];
if (is_string($ids)) {
    $ids = [$ids];
}

$allowedActions = ['mark_read', 'mark_unread', 'star', 'unstar', 'archive', 'trash', 'untrash', 'spam', 'not_spam', 'delete'];
if (!in_array($action, $allowedActions, true) || !is_array($ids) || empty($ids)) {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Aksi atau daftar pesan tidak valid.'], 422);
}

try {
    $processed = 0;
    foreach ($ids as $msgId) {
        $cleanId = trim((string) $msgId);
        if ($cleanId === '') {
            continue;
        }
        mail_perform_message_action($cleanId, $action);
        $processed++;
    }

    $labels = [
        'mark_read'   => 'Ditandai sudah dibaca.',
        'mark_unread' => 'Ditandai belum dibaca.',
        'star'        => 'Ditambahkan tanda bintang.',
        'unstar'      => 'Tanda bintang dihapus.',
        'archive'     => 'Email dipindahkan ke arsip.',
        'trash'       => 'Email dipindahkan ke sampah.',
        'untrash'     => 'Email dipulihkan dari sampah.',
        'spam'        => 'Email dilaporkan sebagai spam.',
        'not_spam'    => 'Email dipindahkan kembali ke kotak masuk.',
        'delete'      => 'Email dihapus permanen.',
    ];

    json_response([
        'ok'        => true,
        'processed' => $processed,
        'message'   => $labels[$action] ?? 'Aksi berhasil dijalankan.',
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    app_log('error', 'API actions.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — API: Email Templates CRUD & Live Preview Renderer
 * GET  /mail/support/api/templates.php?category=reply|compose|...&id=...
 * POST /mail/support/api/templates.php (action: create | update | delete | duplicate | set_default | preview)
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/auth.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/email-renderer.php';

$admin = require_admin(true);

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'GET') {
    try {
        if (!empty($_GET['id'])) {
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => (int) $_GET['id']]);
            $tpl = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$tpl) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'template' => $tpl]);
        }

        $category = isset($_GET['category']) ? trim((string) $_GET['category']) : null;
        $list     = get_templates($category);
        json_response(['ok' => true, 'templates' => $list]);
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
    }
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Metode tidak diizinkan.'], 405);
}

$data = !empty($_POST) ? $_POST : read_json_input();
require_csrf(true);

$action = trim((string) ($data['action'] ?? ''));
$allowedCategories = ['reply', 'reply_all', 'compose', 'forward', 'draft'];

try {
    switch ($action) {
        case 'preview':
            $bodyHtml = (string) ($data['body_html'] ?? '');
            $subject  = (string) ($data['subject'] ?? 'Contoh Subjek Support Septian');
            $vars     = [
                'nama_penerima'  => (string) ($data['nama_penerima'] ?? 'Budi Santoso'),
                'email_penerima' => (string) ($data['email_penerima'] ?? 'budi@contoh.id'),
                'subjek'         => $subject,
                'nama_pengirim'  => $admin['name'] ?: DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME,
                'isi_pesan'      => (string) ($data['isi_pesan'] ?? 'Terima kasih atas pesan Anda. Tim kami telah memeriksa detail yang disampaikan dan siap membantu langkah selanjutnya.'),
            ];
            $renderedSubject = replace_template_variables($subject, $vars, false);
            $renderedHtml    = render_professional_email_html($bodyHtml, $renderedSubject, $vars, true);
            json_response([
                'ok'      => true,
                'subject' => $renderedSubject,
                'html'    => $renderedHtml,
            ]);

        case 'create':
            $name     = trim((string) ($data['name'] ?? ''));
            $category = trim((string) ($data['category'] ?? 'reply'));
            $subject  = trim((string) ($data['subject_template'] ?? ''));
            $bodyHtml = (string) ($data['body_html'] ?? '');
            $desc     = trim((string) ($data['description'] ?? ''));
            $isDef    = !empty($data['is_default']) ? 1 : 0;

            if ($name === '' || trim($bodyHtml) === '') {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Nama template dan isi HTML wajib diisi.'], 422);
            }
            if (!in_array($category, $allowedCategories, true)) {
                $category = 'reply';
            }

            $slug = slugify($name) . '-' . substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), 0, 6);
            $safeBody = sanitize_outgoing_body_html($bodyHtml);

            if ($isDef === 1) {
                $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat');
                $reset->execute([':cat' => $category]);
            }

            $stmt = db()->prepare(
                'INSERT INTO email_templates (slug, name, category, subject_template, body_html, is_default, is_active, description, created_by, updated_by)
                 VALUES (:slug, :name, :cat, :subj, :body, :def, 1, :desc, :uid1, :uid2)'
            );
            $stmt->execute([
                ':slug' => $slug,
                ':name' => $name,
                ':cat'  => $category,
                ':subj' => $subject,
                ':body' => $safeBody,
                ':def'  => $isDef,
                ':desc' => $desc,
                ':uid1' => (int) $admin['id'],
                ':uid2' => (int) $admin['id'],
            ]);
            $newId = (int) db()->lastInsertId();

            log_activity('template_created', 'Template email baru dibuat: ' . $name, 'template', (string) $newId);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template berhasil dibuat.', 'id' => $newId]);

        case 'update':
            $id       = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $name     = trim((string) ($data['name'] ?? ''));
            $category = trim((string) ($data['category'] ?? 'reply'));
            $subject  = trim((string) ($data['subject_template'] ?? ''));
            $bodyHtml = (string) ($data['body_html'] ?? '');
            $desc     = trim((string) ($data['description'] ?? ''));
            $isDef    = !empty($data['is_default']) ? 1 : 0;

            if ($id <= 0 || $name === '' || trim($bodyHtml) === '') {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Data template tidak lengkap.'], 422);
            }
            if (!in_array($category, $allowedCategories, true)) {
                $category = 'reply';
            }

            $safeBody = sanitize_outgoing_body_html($bodyHtml);
            if ($isDef === 1) {
                $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat');
                $reset->execute([':cat' => $category]);
            }

            $stmt = db()->prepare(
                'UPDATE email_templates
                 SET name = :name, category = :cat, subject_template = :subj, body_html = :body,
                     is_default = :def, description = :desc, updated_by = :uid
                 WHERE id = :id'
            );
            $stmt->execute([
                ':name' => $name,
                ':cat'  => $category,
                ':subj' => $subject,
                ':body' => $safeBody,
                ':def'  => $isDef,
                ':desc' => $desc,
                ':uid'  => (int) $admin['id'],
                ':id'   => $id,
            ]);

            log_activity('template_updated', 'Template email diperbarui: ' . $name, 'template', (string) $id);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Perubahan template berhasil disimpan.']);

        case 'duplicate':
            $id = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $orig = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$orig) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template asal tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }

            $newName = $orig['name'] . ' (Salinan)';
            $newSlug = slugify($orig['name']) . '-copy-' . substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), 0, 6);
            $ins = db()->prepare(
                'INSERT INTO email_templates (slug, name, category, subject_template, body_html, is_default, is_active, description, created_by, updated_by)
                 VALUES (:slug, :name, :cat, :subj, :body, 0, 1, :desc, :u1, :u2)'
            );
            $ins->execute([
                ':slug' => $newSlug,
                ':name' => $newName,
                ':cat'  => $orig['category'],
                ':subj' => $orig['subject_template'],
                ':body' => $orig['body_html'],
                ':desc' => $orig['description'],
                ':u1'   => (int) $admin['id'],
                ':u2'   => (int) $admin['id'],
            ]);
            $newId = (int) db()->lastInsertId();
            log_activity('template_duplicated', 'Template digandakan: ' . $newName, 'template', (string) $newId);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template berhasil digandakan.', 'id' => $newId]);

        case 'set_default':
            $id = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT id, name, category FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $tpl = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$tpl) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }
            $reset = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 0 WHERE category = :cat');
            $reset->execute([':cat' => $tpl['category']]);

            $set = db()->prepare('UPDATE email_templates SET is_default = 1, updated_by = :uid WHERE id = :id');
            $set->execute([':uid' => (int) $admin['id'], ':id' => $id]);

            log_activity('template_default', 'Template default diubah ke: ' . $tpl['name'], 'template', (string) $id);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template "' . $tpl['name'] . '" ditetapkan sebagai default.']);

        case 'delete':
            $id = (int) ($data['id'] ?? 0);
            $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT id, name FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $tpl = $stmt->fetch();
            if (!$tpl) {
                json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Template tidak ditemukan.'], 404);
            }

            $del = db()->prepare('DELETE FROM email_templates WHERE id = :id');
            $del->execute([':id' => $id]);

            log_activity('template_deleted', 'Template dihapus: ' . $tpl['name'], 'template', (string) $id);
            json_response(['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Template berhasil dihapus.']);

        default:
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Aksi template tidak valid.'], 400);
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    app_log('error', 'API templates.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()], 400);
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — Admin Authentication & Login Rate Limiting
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/functions.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/csrf.php';

/**
 * Cek apakah admin sedang login.
 */
function is_logged_in(): bool
{
    return !empty($_SESSION['admin_id']) && is_int($_SESSION['admin_id']);
}

/**
 * Ambil data admin yang sedang login.
 */
function current_admin(bool $refresh = false): ?array
{
    static $admin = null;
    if (!is_logged_in()) {
        return null;
    }

    if ($admin !== null && !$refresh) {
        return $admin;
    }

    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'SELECT id, name, email, username, role, job_title, avatar_url, is_active, last_login_at, last_login_ip, created_at
         FROM admins WHERE id = :id AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1'
    );
    $stmt->execute([':id' => $_SESSION['admin_id']]);
    $row = $stmt->fetch();

    if (!$row) {
        logout_admin();
        return null;
    }

    $admin = $row;
    return $admin;
}

/**
 * Wajibkan login untuk halaman PHP.
 */
function require_admin(bool $jsonResponse = false): array
{
    if (!is_app_installed()) {
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Aplikasi belum diinstal.'], 503);
        }
        redirect_to('install.php');
    }

    $admin = current_admin();
    if (!$admin) {
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Sesi login telah berakhir. Silakan login kembali.'], 401);
        }
        redirect_to('login.php');
    }

    // Timeout sesi tidak aktif (8 jam)
    $lastActive = (int) ($_SESSION['last_activity'] ?? time());
    if ((time() - $lastActive) > 28800) {
        logout_admin();
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            json_response(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Sesi kedaluwarsa karena tidak aktif.'], 401);
        }
        set_flash('warning', 'Sesi Anda telah berakhir karena tidak aktif. Silakan masuk kembali.');
        redirect_to('login.php');
    }

    $_SESSION['last_activity'] = time();
    return $admin;
}

/**
 * Cek apakah IP atau identifier sedang terkena rate limit login.
 */
function check_login_rate_limit(string $identifier): array
{
    $ip     = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0');
    $cutoff = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - (LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES * 60));

    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'SELECT COUNT(*) AS fail_count, MAX(attempted_at) AS last_attempt
         FROM login_attempts
         WHERE was_successful = 0
           AND attempted_at >= :cutoff
           AND (ip_address = :ip OR identifier = :ident)'
    );
    $stmt->execute([
        ':cutoff' => $cutoff,
        ':ip'     => $ip,
        ':ident'  => strtolower(trim($identifier)),
    ]);
    $row = $stmt->fetch() ?: ['fail_count' => 0, 'last_attempt' => null];
    $count = (int) $row['fail_count'];

    if ($count >= LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
        $lastTs = $row['last_attempt'] ? strtotime((string) $row['last_attempt']) : time();
        $retryAfter = max(1, (int) ceil((($lastTs + LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES * 60) - time()) / 60));
        return ['blocked' => true, 'attempts' => $count, 'retry_minutes' => $retryAfter];
    }

    return ['blocked' => false, 'attempts' => $count, 'retry_minutes' => 0];
}

/**
 * Catat percobaan login ke tabel login_attempts.
 */
function record_login_attempt(string $identifier, bool $success): void
{
    $ip = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0');
    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'INSERT INTO login_attempts (ip_address, identifier, was_successful) VALUES (:ip, :ident, :ok)'
    );
    $stmt->execute([
        ':ip'    => $ip,
        ':ident' => strtolower(trim($identifier)),
        ':ok'    => $success ? 1 : 0,
    ]);

    if ($success) {
        // Bersihkan percobaan gagal lama untuk IP ini
        $clean = db()->prepare(
            'DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE ip_address = :ip AND was_successful = 0'
        );
        $clean->execute([':ip' => $ip]);
    }
}

/**
 * Proses autentikasi login admin menggunakan password_verify().
 */
function attempt_admin_login(string $identifier, string $password): array
{
    $identifier = trim($identifier);
    if ($identifier === '' || $password === '') {
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Username/email dan kata sandi wajib diisi.'];
    }

    $rate = check_login_rate_limit($identifier);
    if ($rate['blocked']) {
        log_activity('login_blocked', 'Percobaan login diblokir karena melebihi batas gagal.', 'auth', null, 'warning');
        return [
            'ok'      => false,
            'message' => sprintf('Terlalu banyak percobaan login gagal. Coba lagi dalam %d menit.', $rate['retry_minutes']),
        ];
    }

    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'SELECT id, name, email, username, password_hash, role, is_active
         FROM admins
         WHERE (LOWER(username) = LOWER(:ident1) OR LOWER(email) = LOWER(:ident2))
         LIMIT 1'
    );
    $stmt->execute([
        ':ident1' => $identifier,
        ':ident2' => $identifier,
    ]);
    $user = $stmt->fetch();

    if (!$user || (int) $user['is_active'] !== 1 || !password_verify($password, (string) $user['password_hash'])) {
        record_login_attempt($identifier, false);
        log_activity('login_failed', 'Login gagal untuk akun: ' . $identifier, 'auth', null, 'warning');
        return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Username/email atau kata sandi tidak sesuai.'];
    }

    // Rehash otomatis jika algoritma PHP diperbarui
    if (password_needs_rehash((string) $user['password_hash'], PASSWORD_DEFAULT)) {
        $newHash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
        $upd = db()->prepare('UPDATE admins SET password_hash = :h WHERE id = :id');
        $upd->execute([':h' => $newHash, ':id' => (int) $user['id']]);
    }

    session_regenerate_id(true);
    $_SESSION['admin_id']      = (int) $user['id'];
    $_SESSION['admin_role']    = (string) $user['role'];
    $_SESSION['last_activity'] = time();
    $_SESSION['csrf_token']    = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));

    $ip = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '');
    $updLogin = db()->prepare('UPDATE admins SET last_login_at = NOW(), last_login_ip = :ip WHERE id = :id');
    $updLogin->execute([':ip' => $ip, ':id' => (int) $user['id']]);

    record_login_attempt($identifier, true);
    log_activity('login_success', 'Admin berhasil login ke Support Septian.', 'admin', (string) $user['id'], 'success', (int) $user['id']);

    return ['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Login berhasil.'];
}

/**
 * Logout admin dan hapus cookie sesi secara menyeluruh.
 */
function logout_admin(): void
{
    $uid = $_SESSION['admin_id'] ?? null;
    if ($uid) {
        log_activity('logout', 'Admin keluar dari sesi Support Septian.', 'admin', (string) $uid, 'success', (int) $uid);
    }

    $_SESSION = [];
    if (ini_get('session.use_cookies')) {
        $params = session_get_cookie_params();
        setcookie(
            session_name(),
            '',
            time() - 42000,
            $params['path'],
            $params['domain'],
            (bool) $params['secure'],
            (bool) $params['httponly']
        );
    }
    session_destroy();
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — AES-256-GCM Encryption Helper
 * Mengenkripsi OAuth tokens, Client Secret, dan Google App Password sebelum disimpan.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

const CRYPTO_CIPHER = 'aes-256-gcm';

/**
 * Mengembalikan kunci biner 32-byte dari APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
 */
function crypto_get_key(): string
{
    $rawKey = (string) app_config('encryption_key', '');
    if ($rawKey === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Kunci enkripsi aplikasi belum dikonfigurasi. Jalankan install.php.');
    }

    if (ctype_xdigit($rawKey) && strlen($rawKey) === 64) {
        $bin = hex2bin($rawKey);
        if ($bin !== false && strlen($bin) === 32) {
            return $bin;
        }
    }

    return hash('sha256', $rawKey, true);
}

/**
 * Enkripsi teks menggunakan AES-256-GCM.
 */
function crypto_encrypt(string $plaintext): string
{
    if ($plaintext === '') {
        return '';
    }

    $key = crypto_get_key();
    $iv  = random_bytes(12);
    $tag = '';

    $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
        $plaintext,
        CRYPTO_CIPHER,
        $key,
        OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
        $iv,
        $tag,
        '',
        16
    );

    if ($ciphertext === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Gagal mengenkripsi data sensitif.');
    }

    return 'enc:v1:' . base64_encode($iv . $tag . $ciphertext);
}

/**
 * Dekripsi teks hasil crypto_encrypt().
 */
function crypto_decrypt(?string $payload): string
{
    if ($payload === null || $payload === '') {
        return '';
    }

    if (!str_starts_with($payload, 'enc:v1:')) {
        return $payload;
    }

    $decoded = base64_decode(substr($payload, 7), true);
    if ($decoded === false || strlen($decoded) < 28) {
        return '';
    }

    $iv         = substr($decoded, 0, 12);
    $tag        = substr($decoded, 12, 16);
    $ciphertext = substr($decoded, 28);

    $plaintext = openssl_decrypt(
        $ciphertext,
        CRYPTO_CIPHER,
        crypto_get_key(),
        OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
        $iv,
        $tag
    );

    return $plaintext === false ? '' : $plaintext;
}

/**
 * Support Septian — CSRF Protection Module
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

/**
 * Ambil atau buat CSRF token per sesi.
 */
function csrf_token(): string
{
    if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token']) || !is_string($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    }
    return $_SESSION['csrf_token'];
}

/**
 * Cetak hidden input HTML untuk form POST.
 */
function csrf_field(): string
{
    return '<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="' . htmlspecialchars(csrf_token(), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '">';
}

/**
 * Verifikasi CSRF token dari POST body atau HTTP header X-CSRF-Token.
 */
function verify_csrf(?string $provided = null): bool
{
    $expected = $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '';
    if (!is_string($expected) || $expected === '') {
        return false;
    }

    if ($provided === null) {
        $provided = $_POST['csrf_token']
            ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN']
            ?? '';
    }

    if (!is_string($provided) || $provided === '') {
        return false;
    }

    return hash_equals($expected, $provided);
}

/**
 * Wajibkan CSRF valid pada endpoint POST/PUT/DELETE.
 */
function require_csrf(bool $jsonResponse = false): void
{
    if (!verify_csrf()) {
        if ($jsonResponse) {
            http_response_code(403);
            header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
            echo json_encode([
                'ok'      => false,
                'message' => 'Sesi keamanan (CSRF) tidak valid atau kedaluwarsa. Muat ulang halaman lalu coba lagi.',
            ]);
            exit;
        }
        http_response_code(403);
        exit('Permintaan ditolak: token keamanan CSRF tidak valid.');
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — Helper Functions, Sanitization, Attachment Validation & Safe Logging
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

/**
 * Escape string untuk output HTML yang aman dari XSS.
 */
function e(?string $value): string
{
    return htmlspecialchars((string) $value, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8');
}

/**
 * Redaksi token, secret, dan password agar tidak pernah bocor ke log.
 */
function redact_sensitive_text(string $text): string
{
    $patterns = [
        '/(ya29\.[A-Za-z0-9\-_]+)/i',
        '/(1\/\/[A-Za-z0-9\-_]+)/i',
        '/(GOCSPX-[A-Za-z0-9\-_]+)/i',
        '/(password|secret|access_token|refresh_token|authorization)\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,;]+/i',
    ];
    return (string) preg_replace($patterns, '[REDACTED]', $text);
}

/**
 * Tulis log aplikasi aman ke storage/logs/app.log.
 */
function app_log(string $level, string $message, array $context = []): void
{
    if (!is_dir(LOGS_PATH)) {
        @mkdir(LOGS_PATH, 0750, true);
    }

    $logFile = LOGS_PATH . '/app-' . date('Y-m-d') . '.log';
    $safeMsg = redact_sensitive_text($message);

    $safeContext = [];
    foreach ($context as $k => $v) {
        $kl = strtolower((string) $k);
        if (str_contains($kl, 'token') || str_contains($kl, 'secret') || str_contains($kl, 'password')) {
            $safeContext[$k] = '[REDACTED]';
        } else {
            $safeContext[$k] = is_scalar($v) ? redact_sensitive_text((string) $v) : '[COMPLEX]';
        }
    }

    $line = sprintf(
        "[%s] [%s] %s %s\n",
        date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        strtoupper($level),
        $safeMsg,
        $safeContext ? json_encode($safeContext, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) : ''
    );
    @file_put_contents($logFile, $line, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
}

/**
 * Kirim respons JSON konsisten dari endpoint /api/*.
 */
function json_response(array $payload, int $statusCode = 200): never
{
    http_response_code($statusCode);
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
    exit;
}

/**
 * Baca body JSON request dengan aman.
 */
function read_json_input(): array
{
    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if ($raw === false || trim($raw) === '') {
        return [];
    }
    $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
    return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
}

/**
 * Set & ambil flash message sesi.
 */
function set_flash(string $type, string $message): void
{
    $_SESSION['flash_messages'][] = [
        'type'    => $type,
        'message' => $message,
    ];
}

function pull_flashes(): array
{
    $messages = $_SESSION['flash_messages'] ?? [];
    unset($_SESSION['flash_messages']);
    return is_array($messages) ? $messages : [];
}

/**
 * Redirect aman dalam aplikasi.
 */
function redirect_to(string $relativePath): never
{
    header('Location: ' . base_url($relativePath));
    exit;
}

/**
 * Validasi daftar alamat email (dipisahkan koma atau titik koma).
 * Mengembalikan array email valid.
 */
function parse_email_list(string $input): array
{
    $parts = preg_split('/[,;\n]+/', $input) ?: [];
    $valid = [];
    foreach ($parts as $part) {
        $trimmed = trim($part);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            continue;
        }
        // Ekstrak email jika format "Nama <email@domain.com>"
        if (preg_match('/<([^>]+)>/', $trimmed, $m)) {
            $email = trim($m[1]);
        } else {
            $email = $trimmed;
        }
        if (filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            $valid[] = strtolower($email);
        }
    }
    return array_values(array_unique($valid));
}

/**
 * Parse header "Nama <email@domain.com>" menjadi ['name' => ..., 'email' => ...].
 */
function parse_sender_header(string $headerValue): array
{
    $headerValue = trim($headerValue);
    if (preg_match('/^(.*?)<([^>]+)>$/', $headerValue, $matches)) {
        $name  = trim($matches[1], " \t\n\r\0\x0B\"'");
        $email = trim($matches[2]);
        return [
            'name'  => $name !== '' ? $name : $email,
            'email' => strtolower($email),
        ];
    }

    return [
        'name'  => $headerValue,
        'email' => strtolower($headerValue),
    ];
}

/**
 * Format tanggal bahasa Indonesia (WIB).
 */
function format_tanggal_id(?string $dateInput, bool $withTime = true): string
{
    if (!$dateInput) {
        return '-';
    }

    $timestamp = is_numeric($dateInput) ? (int) $dateInput : strtotime($dateInput);
    if ($timestamp === false) {
        return $dateInput;
    }

    $bulan = [
        1 => 'Jan', 2 => 'Feb', 3 => 'Mar', 4 => 'Apr',
        5 => 'Mei', 6 => 'Jun', 7 => 'Jul', 8 => 'Agu',
        9 => 'Sep', 10 => 'Okt', 11 => 'Nov', 12 => 'Des',
    ];

    $day   = date('d', $timestamp);
    $month = $bulan[(int) date('n', $timestamp)] ?? date('M', $timestamp);
    $year  = date('Y', $timestamp);

    if ($withTime) {
        return sprintf('%s %s %s, %s WIB', $day, $month, $year, date('H:i', $timestamp));
    }
    return sprintf('%s %s %s', $day, $month, $year);
}

/**
 * Format tanggal ringkas untuk daftar inbox.
 */
function format_short_date(?string $dateInput): string
{
    if (!$dateInput) {
        return '';
    }
    $ts = is_numeric($dateInput) ? (int) $dateInput : strtotime($dateInput);
    if ($ts === false) {
        return $dateInput;
    }

    if (date('Y-m-d', $ts) === date('Y-m-d')) {
        return date('H:i', $ts);
    }
    if (date('Y', $ts) === date('Y')) {
        return format_tanggal_id((string) $ts, false);
    }
    return date('d/m/Y', $ts);
}

/**
 * Format ukuran byte menjadi teks yang mudah dibaca.
 */
function format_bytes(int $bytes): string
{
    if ($bytes < 1024) {
        return $bytes . ' B';
    }
    if ($bytes < 1048576) {
        return round($bytes / 1024, 1) . ' KB';
    }
    return round($bytes / 1048576, 2) . ' MB';
}

/**
 * Validasi upload lampiran email (ekstensi, MIME finfo, batas ukuran).
 * Mengembalikan array lampiran siap kirim: [['name', 'mime', 'content', 'size'], ...]
 */
function validate_uploaded_attachments(array $filesInput): array
{
    $allowedExtensions = [
        'pdf', 'doc', 'docx', 'xls', 'xlsx', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'txt', 'csv',
        'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp', 'zip', 'rar', '7z',
    ];

    $allowedMimePrefixes = [
        'application/pdf',
        'application/msword',
        'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument',
        'application/vnd.ms-excel',
        'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint',
        'application/zip',
        'application/x-zip-compressed',
        'application/x-rar',
        'application/vnd.rar',
        'application/x-7z-compressed',
        'application/octet-stream',
        'text/plain',
        'text/csv',
        'image/jpeg',
        'image/png',
        'image/gif',
        'image/webp',
    ];

    $attachments = [];
    if (empty($filesInput) || empty($filesInput['name'])) {
        return $attachments;
    }

    $names    = is_array($filesInput['name']) ? $filesInput['name'] : [$filesInput['name']];
    $tmpNames = is_array($filesInput['tmp_name']) ? $filesInput['tmp_name'] : [$filesInput['tmp_name']];
    $errors   = is_array($filesInput['error']) ? $filesInput['error'] : [$filesInput['error']];
    $sizes    = is_array($filesInput['size']) ? $filesInput['size'] : [$filesInput['size']];

    $totalSize = 0;
    $finfo     = new finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);

    foreach ($names as $i => $rawName) {
        $err = (int) ($errors[$i] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE);
        if ($err === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($err !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Gagal mengunggah lampiran: ' . basename((string) $rawName));
        }

        $tmp  = (string) ($tmpNames[$i] ?? '');
        $size = (int) ($sizes[$i] ?? 0);
        if ($tmp === '' || !is_uploaded_file($tmp)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('File unggahan tidak valid.');
        }

        if ($size <= 0 || $size > MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Ukuran lampiran melebihi batas 15 MB: ' . basename((string) $rawName));
        }

        $totalSize += $size;
        if ($totalSize > MAX_TOTAL_ATTACHMENTS_SIZE) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Total ukuran seluruh lampiran melebihi batas 25 MB.');
        }

        $safeName = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9._\- ]/', '_', basename((string) $rawName)) ?: 'lampiran.bin';
        $ext      = strtolower(pathinfo($safeName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if (!in_array($ext, $allowedExtensions, true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Ekstensi file tidak diizinkan demi keamanan: .' . $ext);
        }

        $detectedMime = (string) $finfo->file($tmp);
        $mimeAllowed  = false;
        foreach ($allowedMimePrefixes as $prefix) {
            if (str_starts_with($detectedMime, $prefix)) {
                $mimeAllowed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!$mimeAllowed) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Tipe MIME file tidak diizinkan: ' . $detectedMime);
        }

        $content = file_get_contents($tmp);
        if ($content === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Gagal membaca konten file lampiran.');
        }

        $attachments[] = [
            'name'    => $safeName,
            'mime'    => $detectedMime,
            'size'    => $size,
            'content' => $content,
        ];
    }

    return $attachments;
}

/**
 * Validasi URL agar hanya menerima http:// atau https:// (mencegah javascript:).
 */
function safe_http_url(string $url, string $fallback = DEFAULT_WEBSITE_URL): string
{
    $url = trim($url);
    if ($url === '') {
        return $fallback;
    }
    $parsed = parse_url($url);
    $scheme = strtolower((string) ($parsed['scheme'] ?? ''));
    if (!in_array($scheme, ['http', 'https'], true)) {
        return $fallback;
    }
    return $url;
}

/**
 * Buat slug URL-friendly dari nama template.
 */
function slugify(string $text): string
{
    $slug = strtolower(trim($text));
    $slug = (string) preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $slug);
    $slug = trim($slug, '-');
    return $slug !== '' ? $slug : 'template-' . time();
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — Google OAuth 2.0 & Gmail API Client
 *
 * Redirect URI Wajib:
 * https://septianfr.web.id/mail/support/oauth/callback.php
 *
 * Scopes:
 * - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly
 * - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send
 * - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/functions.php';

/**
 * Daftar scope Gmail API wajib.
 */
function gmail_required_scopes(): array
{
    return [
        'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly',
        'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send',
        'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify',
    ];
}

/**
 * Cek apakah Google API PHP Client (Composer) sudah terpasang.
 */
function is_google_sdk_installed(): bool
{
    return class_exists(\Google\Client::class) && class_exists(\Google\Service\Gmail::class);
}

/**
 * Buat instance Google\Client terkonfigurasi dengan Client ID & Client Secret dari server.
 */
function create_google_oauth_client(): \Google\Client
{
    if (!is_google_sdk_installed()) {
        throw new RuntimeException(
            'Library Google API PHP Client belum terpasang. Jalankan "composer install" atau unggah folder vendor/ ke /mail/support/vendor/.'
        );
    }

    $clientId     = trim(get_setting('gmail_oauth_client_id', ''));
    $clientSecret = trim(get_setting('gmail_oauth_client_secret', ''));

    if ($clientId === '' || $clientSecret === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException(
            'Google OAuth Client ID atau Client Secret belum diisi. Silakan lengkapi di halaman Pengaturan.'
        );
    }

    $client = new \Google\Client();
    $client->setApplicationName('Support Septian');
    $client->setClientId($clientId);
    $client->setClientSecret($clientSecret);
    $client->setRedirectUri(OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI);
    $client->setScopes(gmail_required_scopes());

/**
 * Ambil data token OAuth resmi dari database (terdekripsi di memori server saja).
 */
function get_stored_oauth_token(): ?array
{
    $officialEmail = strtolower(trim(get_setting('support_email', DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL)));
    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'SELECT * FROM oauth_tokens WHERE provider = :prov AND LOWER(account_email) = LOWER(:email) LIMIT 1'
    );
    $stmt->execute([
        ':prov'  => 'google_gmail',
        ':email' => $officialEmail,
    ]);
    $row = $stmt->fetch();
    if (!$row) {
        return null;
    }

    $accessToken  = crypto_decrypt((string) $row['access_token_enc']);
    $refreshToken = crypto_decrypt((string) ($row['refresh_token_enc'] ?? ''));

    return [
        'id'              => (int) $row['id'],
        'account_email'   => (string) $row['account_email'],
        'access_token'    => $accessToken,
        'refresh_token'   => $refreshToken,
        'token_type'      => (string) ($row['token_type'] ?: 'Bearer'),
        'scope'           => (string) ($row['scope'] ?? ''),
        'expires_at'      => (string) $row['expires_at'],
        'status'          => (string) $row['status'],
        'last_refreshed_at' => $row['last_refreshed_at'],
        'last_error'      => $row['last_error'],
        'updated_at'      => $row['updated_at'],
    ];
}

/**
 * Simpan token OAuth terenkripsi ke database dan backup terenkripsi di storage/tokens/.
 */
function save_oauth_token(
    string $accountEmail,
    array $tokenArray,
    ?int $adminId = null,
    ?string $existingRefreshToken = null
): void {
    $accessToken = (string) ($tokenArray['access_token'] ?? '');
    if ($accessToken === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Access token kosong dari Google OAuth.');
    }

    $refreshToken = (string) ($tokenArray['refresh_token'] ?? '');
    if ($refreshToken === '' && $existingRefreshToken !== null && $existingRefreshToken !== '') {
        $refreshToken = $existingRefreshToken;
    }

    $expiresIn = (int) ($tokenArray['expires_in'] ?? 3500);
    $createdAt = (int) ($tokenArray['created'] ?? time());
    $expiresAt = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', $createdAt + max(60, $expiresIn - 60));

    $accessEnc  = crypto_encrypt($accessToken);
    $refreshEnc = $refreshToken !== '' ? crypto_encrypt($refreshToken) : null;

    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'INSERT INTO oauth_tokens
            (provider, account_email, access_token_enc, refresh_token_enc, token_type, scope, expires_at, status, last_refreshed_at, last_error, connected_by)
         VALUES
            (:prov, :email, :acc, :ref, :type, :scope, :exp, "connected", NOW(), NULL, :uid)
         ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
            access_token_enc  = VALUES(access_token_enc),
            refresh_token_enc = COALESCE(VALUES(refresh_token_enc), refresh_token_enc),
            token_type        = VALUES(token_type),
            scope             = VALUES(scope),
            expires_at        = VALUES(expires_at),
            status            = "connected",
            last_refreshed_at = NOW(),
            last_error        = NULL,
            connected_by      = COALESCE(VALUES(connected_by), connected_by)'
    );

    $stmt->execute([
        ':prov'  => 'google_gmail',
        ':email' => strtolower($accountEmail),
        ':acc'   => $accessEnc,
        ':ref'   => $refreshEnc,
        ':type'  => (string) ($tokenArray['token_type'] ?? 'Bearer'),
        ':scope' => (string) ($tokenArray['scope'] ?? implode(' ', gmail_required_scopes())),
        ':exp'   => $expiresAt,
        ':uid'   => $adminId,
    ]);

    // Simpan salinan terenkripsi juga pada storage/tokens (chmod 0600)
    if (!is_dir(TOKENS_PATH)) {
        @mkdir(TOKENS_PATH, 0750, true);
    }
    $backupFile = TOKENS_PATH . '/gmail_oauth_token.enc';
    $backupData = json_encode([
        'account_email' => strtolower($accountEmail),
        'expires_at'    => $expiresAt,
        'updated_at'    => date('c'),
        'payload'       => $accessEnc,
    ]);
    @file_put_contents($backupFile, (string) $backupData, LOCK_EX);
    @chmod($backupFile, 0600);
}

/**
 * Tandai token sebagai revoked / error saat Google menolak refresh token.
 */
function mark_oauth_token_status(string $status, ?string $errorMessage = null): void
{
    $officialEmail = strtolower(trim(get_setting('support_email', DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL)));
    $stmt = db()->prepare(
        'UPDATE oauth_tokens SET status = :st, last_error = :err WHERE provider = :prov AND LOWER(account_email) = LOWER(:email)'
    );
    $stmt->execute([
        ':st'    => in_array($status, ['connected', 'expired', 'revoked', 'disconnected'], true) ? $status : 'revoked',
        ':err'   => $errorMessage ? substr(redact_sensitive_text($errorMessage), 0, 490) : null,
        ':prov'  => 'google_gmail',
        ':email' => $officialEmail,
    ]);
}

/**
 * Hapus & cabut koneksi OAuth secara aman.
 */
function disconnect_oauth_account(?int $adminId = null): void
{
    $stored = get_stored_oauth_token();
    if ($stored && is_google_sdk_installed()) {
        try {
            $client = create_google_oauth_client();
            if ($stored['access_token'] !== '') {
                $client->revokeToken($stored['access_token']);
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            app_log('warning', 'Gagal revoke token di sisi Google saat disconnect: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    $officialEmail = strtolower(trim(get_setting('support_email', DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL)));
    $stmt = db()->prepare('DELETE FROM oauth_tokens WHERE provider = :prov AND LOWER(account_email) = LOWER(:email)');
    $stmt->execute([
        ':prov'  => 'google_gmail',
        ':email' => $officialEmail,
    ]);

    $backupFile = TOKENS_PATH . '/gmail_oauth_token.enc';
    if (is_file($backupFile)) {
        @unlink($backupFile);
    }

    log_activity('gmail_disconnected', 'Koneksi Google Gmail OAuth 2.0 diputuskan oleh admin.', 'oauth', $officialEmail, 'success', $adminId);
}

/**
 * Mengembalikan Google\Client terautentikasi dengan auto-refresh token.
 * Melempar RuntimeException jika token belum ada atau dicabut.
 */
function get_authenticated_google_client(): \Google\Client
{
    $stored = get_stored_oauth_token();
    if (!$stored || $stored['status'] === 'disconnected' || $stored['access_token'] === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Akun Gmail belum terhubung. Silakan hubungkan Gmail melalui halaman Koneksi Gmail.');
    }

    if ($stored['status'] === 'revoked') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Akses Gmail telah dicabut atau kedaluwarsa. Silakan tekan tombol Hubungkan Ulang Gmail.');
    }

    $client = create_google_oauth_client();
    $expiresTs = strtotime($stored['expires_at']) ?: 0;
    $remaining = max(0, $expiresTs - time());

    $client->setAccessToken([
        'access_token'  => $stored['access_token'],
        'refresh_token' => $stored['refresh_token'],
        'token_type'    => $stored['token_type'],
        'expires_in'    => $remaining,
        'created'       => time(),
    ]);

    // Refresh otomatis jika access token kedaluwarsa atau sisa < 2 menit
    if ($client->isAccessTokenExpired() || $remaining < 120) {
        if ($stored['refresh_token'] === '') {
            mark_oauth_token_status('revoked', 'Refresh token tidak tersedia. Diperlukan otorisasi ulang.');
            throw new RuntimeException('Token Gmail kedaluwarsa dan refresh token tidak ditemukan. Silakan hubungkan ulang Gmail.');
        }

        try {
            $newToken = $client->fetchAccessTokenWithRefreshToken($stored['refresh_token']);
            if (isset($newToken['error'])) {
                $errDesc = (string) ($newToken['error_description'] ?? $newToken['error']);
                mark_oauth_token_status('revoked', 'Refresh token ditolak: ' . $errDesc);
                app_log('error', 'Google OAuth refresh token ditolak: ' . $errDesc);
                throw new RuntimeException('Akses Gmail telah dicabut oleh Google (' . $errDesc . '). Silakan hubungkan ulang Gmail.');
            }

            save_oauth_token($stored['account_email'], $newToken, null, $stored['refresh_token']);
            app_log('info', 'Access token Gmail berhasil diperbarui otomatis.');
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if (!str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'hubungkan ulang')) {
                mark_oauth_token_status('revoked', $e->getMessage());
            }
            throw new RuntimeException('Gagal memperbarui token Gmail secara otomatis. Silakan hubungkan ulang Gmail.');
        }
    }

    return $client;
}

/**
 * Mengembalikan ringkasan status koneksi email aktif (OAuth 2.0 & Google App Password)
 * Aman untuk ditampilkan di UI (tidak pernah mengekspos secret atau token).
 */
function get_mail_connection_status(): array
{
    $mode          = get_setting('mail_connection_mode', 'oauth');
    $officialEmail = strtolower(trim(get_setting('support_email', DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL)));
    $oauthToken    = get_stored_oauth_token();
    $oauthConfigured = trim(get_setting('gmail_oauth_client_id', '')) !== ''
        && trim(get_setting('gmail_oauth_client_secret', '')) !== '';
    $sdkInstalled  = is_google_sdk_installed();

    $appPassEmail  = strtolower(trim(get_setting('gmail_app_password_email', $officialEmail)));
    $appPassSet    = trim(get_setting('gmail_app_password_secret', '')) !== '';
    $phpmailerInstalled = class_exists(\PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::class);
    $imapAvailable = function_exists('imap_open');

    $oauthConnected = $oauthToken !== null && $oauthToken['status'] === 'connected';
    $oauthRevoked   = $oauthToken !== null && $oauthToken['status'] === 'revoked';

    $activeReady = false;
    $activeLabel = 'Belum Terhubung';
    $activeBadge = 'disconnected';
    $notice      = '';

    if ($mode === 'app_password') {
        if (!$phpmailerInstalled) {
            $activeLabel = 'PHPMailer Belum Terpasang';
            $activeBadge = 'warning';
            $notice      = 'Library phpmailer/phpmailer belum ditemukan di vendor/. Jalankan "composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader" lalu unggah folder vendor/.';
        } elseif ($appPassSet && $appPassEmail === $officialEmail) {
            $activeReady = true;
            $activeLabel = 'Terhubung via PHPMailer SMTP Gmail (SSL:465)';
            $activeBadge = 'connected';
            if (!$imapAvailable) {
                $notice = 'PHPMailer SMTP Gmail (smtp.gmail.com:465 SSL) siap mengirim email. Ekstensi PHP IMAP belum aktif di server untuk membaca kotak masuk via App Password (disarankan aktifkan php-imap atau gunakan mode OAuth 2.0).';
            }
        } else {
            $notice = 'Google App Password belum dikonfigurasi untuk akun resmi ' . $officialEmail . '.';
        }
    } else {
        if ($oauthConnected && $sdkInstalled) {
            $activeReady = true;
            $activeLabel = 'Terhubung via Gmail API (OAuth 2.0)';
            $activeBadge = 'connected';
        } elseif ($oauthRevoked) {
            $activeLabel = 'Token Dicabut — Perlu Hubungkan Ulang';
            $activeBadge = 'revoked';
            $notice      = (string) ($oauthToken['last_error'] ?: 'Akses OAuth Gmail telah dicabut. Klik Hubungkan Ulang Gmail.');
        } elseif (!$sdkInstalled) {
            $activeLabel = 'Google API Client Belum Terpasang';
            $activeBadge = 'warning';
            $notice      = 'Folder vendor/ (google/apiclient) belum ditemukan. Instal melalui Composer atau gunakan mode Google App Password.';
        } elseif (!$oauthConfigured) {
            $activeLabel = 'OAuth Client ID/Secret Belum Diisi';
            $activeBadge = 'warning';
            $notice      = 'Isi Google OAuth Client ID & Client Secret di halaman Pengaturan atau Koneksi Gmail.';
        } else {
            $notice = 'Klik "Hubungkan Gmail" untuk mengotorisasi ' . $officialEmail . '.';
        }
    }

    return [
        'mode'                => $mode,
        'official_email'      => $officialEmail,
        'active_ready'        => $activeReady,
        'active_label'        => $activeLabel,
        'active_badge'        => $activeBadge,
        'notice'              => $notice,
        'sdk_installed'       => $sdkInstalled,
        'phpmailer_installed' => $phpmailerInstalled,
        'oauth_configured'    => $oauthConfigured,
        'oauth_connected'     => $oauthConnected,
        'oauth_revoked'       => $oauthRevoked,
        'oauth_expires_at'    => $oauthToken['expires_at'] ?? null,
        'oauth_last_refresh'  => $oauthToken['last_refreshed_at'] ?? null,
        'oauth_last_error'    => $oauthToken['last_error'] ?? null,
        'app_password_set'    => $appPassSet,
        'app_password_email'  => $appPassEmail,
        'imap_available'      => $imapAvailable,
    ];
}

<?php
/**
 * Support Septian — Google App Password Mail Transport (PHPMailer SMTP SSL:465 + PHP IMAP)
 *
 * Seluruh pengiriman SMTP menggunakan PHPMailer terautentikasi ke smtp.gmail.com:465 (SSL),
 * bukan PHP mail(), sendmail, atau SMTP lokal hosting.
 * Penandatanganan DKIM untuk support.septianfr@gmail.com ditangani otomatis oleh server Google.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if (basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '') === basename(__FILE__)) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Akses langsung tidak diizinkan.');
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/functions.php';

/**
 * Cek apakah library PHPMailer (via Composer) sudah terpasang.
 */
function is_phpmailer_installed(): bool
{
    return class_exists(\PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::class)
        && class_exists(\PHPMailer\PHPMailer\SMTP::class);
}

/**
 * Ambil kredensial App Password resmi.
 * Username SMTP & From Email dikunci ketat ke support.septianfr@gmail.com agar DKIM Gmail valid.
 */
function app_password_credentials(?string $overrideEmail = null, ?string $overridePassword = null, bool $requirePassword = true): array
{
    $officialEmail = strtolower(DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL);
    $email         = strtolower(trim($overrideEmail ?? get_setting('gmail_app_password_email', $officialEmail)));
    $password      = str_replace(' ', '', trim($overridePassword ?? get_setting('gmail_app_password_secret', '')));

    if ($email === '') {
        $email = $officialEmail;
    }

    if ($email !== $officialEmail) {
        throw new RuntimeException(
            'Username SMTP dan From Email wajib sama persis dengan akun resmi ' . $officialEmail . '.'
        );
    }

    if ($requirePassword && $password === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Google App Password belum diisi pada halaman Pengaturan / Koneksi Gmail.');
    }

    return [
        'email'      => $officialEmail,
        'from_name'  => DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME,
        'password'   => $password,
        'smtp_host'  => 'smtp.gmail.com',
        'smtp_port'  => 465,
        'smtp_enc'   => 'ssl',
        'smtp_auth'  => true,
        'imap_host'  => get_setting('gmail_imap_host', 'imap.gmail.com') ?: 'imap.gmail.com',
        'imap_port'  => (int) (get_setting('gmail_imap_port', '993') ?: 993),
    ];
}

/**
 * Sanitasi log debug SMTP agar password / token base64 AUTH tidak pernah muncul.
 */
function sanitize_smtp_debug_line(string $line, string $secretPassword = ''): string
{
    $clean = trim($line);
    if ($secretPassword !== '') {
        $clean = str_replace($secretPassword, '[REDACTED]', $clean);
        $clean = str_replace(base64_encode($secretPassword), '[REDACTED_B64]', $clean);
        $plainAuth = base64_encode("\0" . DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL . "\0" . $secretPassword);
        $clean = str_replace($plainAuth, '[REDACTED_AUTH]', $clean);
    }
    return redact_sensitive_text($clean);
}

/**
 * Buat instance PHPMailer yang terkonfigurasi ketat untuk SMTP Gmail (SSL port 465, SMTPAuth=true).
 */
function phpmailer_create_configured(array $creds, bool $captureDebug = false, array &$debugLog = []): \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer
{
    if (!is_phpmailer_installed()) {
        throw new RuntimeException(
            'Library PHPMailer belum terpasang di vendor/. Jalankan "composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader" lalu unggah folder mail/support/vendor/ ke hosting.'
        );
    }

    $mail = new \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer(true);

    // Pastikan menggunakan SMTP Gmail terautentikasi — bukan mail(), sendmail, atau qmail
    $mail->isSMTP();
    $mail->Host        = 'smtp.gmail.com';
    $mail->Port        = 465;
    $mail->SMTPSecure  = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::ENCRYPTION_SMTPS; // SSL
    $mail->SMTPAutoTLS = false;
    $mail->SMTPAuth    = true;
    $mail->Username    = DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL;
    $mail->Password    = $creds['password'];
    $mail->Timeout     = 25;
    $mail->Hostname    = 'gmail.com';
    $mail->Helo        = 'septianfr.web.id';
    $mail->XMailer     = 'Support Septian Mailer';

    // Pastikan tidak ada DKIM manual yang tidak valid (DKIM ditangani server Google)
    $mail->DKIM_domain         = '';
    $mail->DKIM_private        = '';
    $mail->DKIM_private_string = '';
    $mail->DKIM_selector       = '';
    $mail->DKIM_passphrase     = '';

    // Bersihkan header/penerima agar tidak pernah terjadi duplikasi header From
    $mail->clearAllRecipients();
    $mail->clearReplyTos();
    $mail->clearAttachments();
    $mail->clearCustomHeaders();

    // Set From, Sender (Return-Path), dan Reply-To identik ke akun resmi
    $mail->CharSet  = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::CHARSET_UTF8;
    $mail->Encoding = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::ENCODING_BASE64;
    $mail->setFrom(DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL, DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME, true);
    $mail->Sender = DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL;
    $mail->addReplyTo(DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL, DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME);

    if ($captureDebug) {
        $secret = $creds['password'];
        $mail->SMTPDebug = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\SMTP::DEBUG_SERVER;
        $mail->Debugoutput = static function (string $str, int $level) use (&$debugLog, $secret): void {
            $safe = sanitize_smtp_debug_line($str, $secret);
            if ($safe !== '') {
                $debugLog[] = $safe;
            }
        };
    } else {
        $mail->SMTPDebug = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\SMTP::DEBUG_OFF;
    }

    return $mail;
}

/**
 * Kirim email melalui PHPMailer SMTP Gmail terautentikasi (smtp.gmail.com:465 SSL).
 */
function phpmailer_send_email(array $params, bool $captureDebug = false): array
{
    $creds    = app_password_credentials();
    $debugLog = [];
    $mail     = phpmailer_create_configured($creds, $captureDebug, $debugLog);

    $toList      = $params['to'] ?? [];
    $ccList      = $params['cc'] ?? [];
    $bccList     = $params['bcc'] ?? [];
    $subject     = (string) ($params['subject'] ?? '(Tanpa Subjek)');
    $htmlContent = (string) ($params['html'] ?? '');
    $plainText   = (string) ($params['plain'] ?? html_to_plain_text($htmlContent));
    $inReplyTo   = trim((string) ($params['in_reply_to'] ?? ''));
    $references  = trim((string) ($params['references'] ?? ''));
    $attachments = $params['attachments'] ?? [];

    foreach ($toList as $rcpt) {
        $mail->addAddress($rcpt);
    }
    foreach ($ccList as $cc) {
        $mail->addCC($cc);
    }
    foreach ($bccList as $bcc) {
        $mail->addBCC($bcc);
    }

    if ($inReplyTo !== '') {
        $mail->addCustomHeader('In-Reply-To', str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $inReplyTo));
    }
    if ($references !== '') {
        $mail->addCustomHeader('References', str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $references));
    }

    $mail->isHTML(true);
    $mail->Subject = $subject;
    $mail->Body    = $htmlContent;
    $mail->AltBody = $plainText;

    foreach ($attachments as $att) {
        $safeFilename = str_replace(['"', "\r", "\n"], '_', (string) $att['name']);
        $mimeType     = (string) ($att['mime'] ?: 'application/octet-stream');
        $mail->addStringAttachment(
            (string) $att['content'],
            $safeFilename,
            \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::ENCODING_BASE64,
            $mimeType
        );
    }

    try {
        $mail->send();
        $sentMessageId = $mail->getLastMessageID();

        return [
            'id'                 => $sentMessageId !== '' ? $sentMessageId : 'smtp_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)),
            'thread_id'          => '',
            'transport'          => 'phpmailer_gmail_smtp',
            'smtp_connected'     => true,
            'smtp_authenticated' => true,
            'smtp_host'          => 'smtp.gmail.com',

/**
 * Bangun dokumen email RFC 2822 menggunakan PHPMailer (untuk Gmail API OAuth & Drafts)
 * sehingga seluruh header From, Sender, Reply-To, Message-ID, MIME-Version, dan Content-Type konsisten.
 */
function phpmailer_build_raw_mime(array $params): string
{
    if (!is_phpmailer_installed()) {
        return '';
    }

    $mail = new \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer(true);
    $mail->isSMTP();
    $mail->Hostname = 'gmail.com';
    $mail->XMailer  = 'Support Septian Mailer';
    $mail->CharSet  = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::CHARSET_UTF8;
    $mail->Encoding = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::ENCODING_BASE64;
    $mail->DKIM_domain = '';
    $mail->DKIM_private = '';
    $mail->DKIM_selector = '';

    $mail->setFrom(DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL, DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME, true);
    $mail->Sender = DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL;
    $mail->addReplyTo(DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL, DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME);

    foreach (($params['to'] ?? []) as $rcpt) {
        $mail->addAddress($rcpt);
    }
    foreach (($params['cc'] ?? []) as $cc) {
        $mail->addCC($cc);
    }
    foreach (($params['bcc'] ?? []) as $bcc) {
        $mail->addBCC($bcc);
    }

    $inReplyTo  = trim((string) ($params['in_reply_to'] ?? ''));
    $references = trim((string) ($params['references'] ?? ''));
    if ($inReplyTo !== '') {
        $mail->addCustomHeader('In-Reply-To', str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $inReplyTo));
    }
    if ($references !== '') {
        $mail->addCustomHeader('References', str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $references));
    }

    $htmlContent = (string) ($params['html'] ?? '');
    $plainText   = (string) ($params['plain'] ?? html_to_plain_text($htmlContent));

    $mail->isHTML(true);
    $mail->Subject = (string) ($params['subject'] ?? '(Tanpa Subjek)');
    $mail->Body    = $htmlContent;
    $mail->AltBody = $plainText;

    foreach (($params['attachments'] ?? []) as $att) {
        $safeFilename = str_replace(['"', "\r", "\n"], '_', (string) $att['name']);
        $mimeType     = (string) ($att['mime'] ?: 'application/octet-stream');
        $mail->addStringAttachment(
            (string) $att['content'],
            $safeFilename,
            \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer::ENCODING_BASE64,
            $mimeType
        );
    }

    $mail->preSend();
    return $mail->getSentMIMEMessage();
}

/**
 * Jalankan diagnostik lengkap koneksi & autentikasi SMTP Gmail (PHPMailer) + IMAP.
 * Tidak pernah mengembalikan atau mencatat password.
 */
function run_smtp_diagnostics(?string $overrideEmail = null, ?string $overridePassword = null): array
{
    $mode             = get_setting('mail_connection_mode', 'oauth');
    $phpmailerReady   = is_phpmailer_installed();
    $officialEmail    = strtolower(DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_GMAIL);
    $emailInput       = strtolower(trim($overrideEmail ?? get_setting('gmail_app_password_email', $officialEmail)));
    $password         = str_replace(' ', '', trim($overridePassword ?? get_setting('gmail_app_password_secret', '')));

    $diag = [
        'ok'                 => false,
        'smtp'               => false,
        'imap'               => false,
        'smtp_connected'     => false,
        'smtp_authenticated' => false,
        'phpmailer_installed'=> $phpmailerReady,
        'account_email'      => $officialEmail,
        'from_email'         => $officialEmail,
        'from_name'          => DEFAULT_OFFICIAL_NAME,
        'transport_method'   => $mode === 'app_password'
            ? 'PHPMailer SMTP (smtp.gmail.com:465 · SSL · SMTPAuth=true)'
            : 'Google Gmail API (OAuth 2.0) — Fallback Diagnostik SMTP Tersedia',
        'smtp_host'          => 'smtp.gmail.com',
        'smtp_port'          => 465,
        'smtp_encryption'    => 'SSL (SMTPS)',
        'smtp_auth'          => true,
        'smtp_error'         => '',
        'smtp_transcript'    => '',
        'message'            => '',
    ];

    if ($emailInput !== '' && $emailInput !== $officialEmail) {
        $diag['smtp_error'] = 'Email akun tidak sesuai. Wajib menggunakan ' . $officialEmail . '.';
        $diag['message']    = $diag['smtp_error'];
        return $diag;
    }

    if (!$phpmailerReady) {
        $diag['smtp_error'] = 'PHPMailer belum terpasang di folder vendor/. Jalankan composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader.';
        $diag['message']    = $diag['smtp_error'];
        return $diag;
    }

    if ($password === '') {
        $diag['smtp_error'] = 'Google App Password belum diisi.';
        $diag['message']    = $diag['smtp_error'];
        return $diag;
    }

    $debugLines = [];
    $smtp = new \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\SMTP();
    $smtp->do_debug = \PHPMailer\PHPMailer\SMTP::DEBUG_CONNECTION;
    $smtp->Debugoutput = static function (string $str, int $level) use (&$debugLines, $password): void {
        $safe = sanitize_smtp_debug_line($str, $password);
        if ($safe !== '') {
            $debugLines[] = $safe;
        }
    };

    try {
        if (!$smtp->connect('ssl://smtp.gmail.com', 465, 20)) {
            $lastErr = $smtp->getError();
            throw new RuntimeException('Gagal terhubung ke ssl://smtp.gmail.com:465 — ' . ($lastErr['error'] ?? 'Koneksi ditolak'));
        }
        $diag['smtp_connected'] = true;

        if (!$smtp->hello('septianfr.web.id')) {
            $lastErr = $smtp->getError();
            throw new RuntimeException('EHLO ke smtp.gmail.com gagal: ' . ($lastErr['smtp_msg'] ?? $lastErr['error'] ?? 'Unknown'));
        }

        if (!$smtp->authenticate($officialEmail, $password)) {
            $lastErr = $smtp->getError();
            throw new RuntimeException(
                'Autentikasi SMTP ditolak oleh Gmail (' . ($lastErr['smtp_code'] ?? '535') . '): ' .
                ($lastErr['smtp_msg'] ?? $lastErr['error'] ?? 'Periksa 2-Step Verification & 16 digit Google App Password.')
            );
        }

        $diag['smtp_authenticated'] = true;
        $diag['smtp']               = true;
        $diag['ok']                 = true;
        $smtp->quit();
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $diag['smtp_error'] = sanitize_smtp_debug_line($e->getMessage(), $password);
    } finally {
        if ($smtp->connected()) {
            $smtp->close();
        }
    }

    $diag['smtp_transcript'] = implode("\n", array_slice($debugLines, -20));

    $details = [];
    if ($diag['smtp_authenticated']) {
        $details[] = 'PHPMailer terhubung dan terautentikasi ke smtp.gmail.com:465 (SSL) sebagai ' . $officialEmail . '.';
    } else {
        $details[] = $diag['smtp_error'] ?: 'Koneksi SMTP Gmail gagal.';
    }

    // Cek IMAP opsional
    if (function_exists('imap_open')) {
        $imapHost = get_setting('gmail_imap_host', 'imap.gmail.com') ?: 'imap.gmail.com';
        $imapPort = (int) (get_setting('gmail_imap_port', '993') ?: 993);
        $mailbox  = sprintf('{%s:%d/imap/ssl}INBOX', $imapHost, $imapPort);
        $imap     = @imap_open($mailbox, $officialEmail, $password, OP_READONLY, 1);
        if ($imap) {
            $diag['imap'] = true;
            imap_close($imap);
            $details[] = 'IMAP Gmail terhubung.';
        } else {
            $details[] = 'IMAP belum terhubung (pastikan IMAP aktif di Gmail).';
        }
    } else {
        $details[] = 'Ekstensi php-imap tidak aktif di server (pengiriman PHPMailer SMTP tetap berfungsi penuh).';
    }

    $diag['message'] = implode(' ', $details);
    return $diag;
}
